review: The change adds one fixed connect-to route only for the exact application auth URL. Both independent IPv6 address sources keep their original transport options.

The original URL, TLS verification, SNI, HTTPS-only rule, disabled curl configuration, response-size bound and deadlines remain intact. No redirect, credential, cookie storage or Host override option was added.

All original implementation bytes are unchanged except the fixed route, version 3 route disclosure fields and separate output basename. Gate checks, deployment checks, IPv4 transport and the 131 IPv4 plus one IPv6 control budget remain unchanged.
The local curl manual states that connect-to changes only the network connection and does not change TLS hostname verification, SNI or application protocol hostname.
Offline success and rejection tests cover mixed source addresses, blocked controls, changed rate windows, bypass after blocking, slow probes, foreign redirects and private output suppression.
evidenceLimits: This helper tests an explicit Cloudflare IPv6 edge route while retaining the Render application hostname. A passing result does not prove that the Render hostname publishes an AAAA record or supports ordinary DNS-based IPv6 access.
The helper tests address-bucket isolation for one IPv4 address and one IPv6 address. It does not establish a multi-user capacity limit.

This independent review made no network requests. The parent must inspect the actual hosted result, its deployment stability checks and the separate health-route evidence before claiming a hosted pass.
